_comment: Ire's Blockchain — genesis parameter overrides. Merge these into the base genesis.json produced by `ignite scaffold chain` / `ired init`. Values here define the permanent, one-time supply.

total_supply._comment: 1 trillion IRE, denominated in uire (micro-IRE). This is the ONLY minting event that ever occurs.

mint._comment: Standard x/mint module is REPLACED by x/ire-mint (see /x/ire-mint). If you have not yet swapped the module, at minimum set inflation params to zero as a stopgap — but this is a policy setting, not a hard guarantee, until the module itself is removed.

gov._comment: Governance can adjust things like voting periods and deposit minimums, but the mint module's absence is a code-level fact, not a gov param — no proposal can re-enable minting without a coordinated hard fork.

wasm._comment: CosmWasm module config. code_upload_access controls who can upload contract code; instantiate_default_permission affects who can instantiate. Deploy your NFT/token contracts with --no-admin on the CLI to make them individually immutable regardless of these defaults.
